title: Webapp entry token payload
description: Payload of the signed token in ?t= for webapp entry (before HMAC signature). Used by the integrator bot and webapp. A person is named ONLY by canonical UUID or by a channel binding: Track D (#987) retired the numeric public integrator user id, and `additionalProperties: false` is what keeps it — and every other unknown key — out. Webapp rejects any payload whose key set is not a subset of `properties`, so an old signed token carrying the retired field stays rejected without the retired field living in active code.

sub.description: Channel-scoped entry subject, e.g. tg:123456789 or max:123456789. Not an account id.

role.description: Session role seed for an ALREADY EXISTING account; it never creates one.

platformUserId.description: Canonical `public.platform_users.id`, present only when an existing binding already resolved it. Absent means "webapp resolves the person from `bindings` alone"; it never means "create one".

bindings.description: Channel bindings. Known keys: telegramId, maxId, vkId (string values). At least one may be present when user enters from a messenger.
